subject: Corridor assignment proposal: NovaEdge integration (EdgeCom corridor)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novaedge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Corridor question — NovaEdge / EdgeCom integration

Hi Jonas (and team),

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration hooks are exactly what EdgeCom needs. Before we proceed to a joint outreach, EdgeCom has asked us to confirm who will be the owning partner for accounts that fall into the "Midwest Corridor" (they specifically called out EdgeCom, OrbitTech, and Meridian Health). Historically Atlas has led consultative deals in that geography, but NovaEdge believes the product-led integration & developer tooling there makes them the primary owner for initial scoping and POC.

Can you confirm Redwood's proposed corridor assignment logic so we can present a clean MOU to EdgeCom? Specifically:
- Which partner owns initial outreach / POC?
- Escalation path for enterprise procurement / co-sell?
- Any minimum ARR threshold for escalation to Atlas?

We're aiming to get a signed partner handoff doc in the next two weeks so EdgeCom can start integration work. Happy to hop on a 20–30m call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, NovaEdge
Elena Morales
elena@novaedge.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: none (will share NovaEdge referral terms after confirmation)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novaedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Corridor question — NovaEdge / EdgeCom integration

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: propose a corridor split by go-to-market motion (developer-led vs consultative expansion) + an ARR tipping point. Draft attached (Corridor_Mapping_v1.xlsx) and suggested FAQ below.

Proposal (high level):
- Initial outreach & POC: owner = partner who provides the integration + owns developer traction (NovaEdge for developer-first flows).
- Procurement / Enterprise expansion: owner = partner with primary consulting relationship / incumbent (Atlas in cases where > $250k ARR or if Atlas is the historical reseller).
- Dual-ownership cases: co-sell with a primary owner and a named escalation contact; revenue split and referral credit defined in the MOU.

Escalation path: Primary partner -> Redwood channel rep (Sergio) -> Redwood strategic accounts (Laura) for disputes or exceptions.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the $250k ARR threshold with you and Atlas.
2) Marissa to produce the handoff matrix and HubSpot ownership mapping.
3) If agreed, we publish the corridor mapping in the partner portal and create an MPO in HubSpot.

I can do a short sync Thurs 5/20 at 10:00am PT or Fri 5/21 at 9:00am PT — which works for you and David at Atlas?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: Corridor_Mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: proposed corridor-by-account and escalation rules)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@novaedge.ai>, David Korver <david.korver@atlasconsult.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Corridor question — NovaEdge / EdgeCom integration

Looping in a compact mapping excerpt from Corridor_Mapping_v1 (see attached PDF we normally share with partners). Quick notes:
- Suggested rule: if expected FY ARR >= $250k OR enterprise procurement leads within 60 days -> route to Atlas for consultative sales.
- For developer-led POCs (< $250k): NovaEdge owns POC, Redwood provides sandbox credits and engineering enablement.
- If Atlas is an incumbent reseller for the named account, Atlas gets primary ownership regardless of ARR.

Operational ask for Redwood ops (Sergio): please add the following fields to the HubSpot partner mapping record: partner_primary_owner, escalation_contact, revenue_threshold_usd, partner_incumbent_flag. I added a draft HubSpot link here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/edgecom

Elena / David — if you're good with the $250k threshold and the incumbent override, we'll finalize and ask legal to include a short referral SLA (turnaround on introductions, 30-day follow-up cadence).

Marissa Cole
Partner Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: NovaEdge_Referral_Terms.pdf (summary of referral SLAs we typically use)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novaedge.ai>, David Korver <david.korver@atlasconsult.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Corridor question — NovaEdge / EdgeCom integration

All — thank you. Based on responses: agreement on $250k threshold + incumbent override. Actions assigned below.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize the partner handoff matrix and post to the partner portal (due 2027-05-24).
- Sergio: add partner mapping fields to HubSpot and create MPO for EdgeCom (HubSpot link above) (due 2027-05-24).
- Laura: be escalation owner for any disputed corridors > $250k; coordinate legal for the referral SLA language.
- Elena / David: please confirm Atlas incumbent status for EdgeCom by 2027-05-24. If confirmed, Atlas will be primary owner for enterprise expansion.

I'll draft the short MOU once Marissa posts the matrix and will circulate for signatures (DocuSign). Thanks everyone for the quick turn here — once this pattern is published we should be able to speed partner introductions and keep the pipeline clean.

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
